details.effects: Reports, as an unverified personal record, the material, whole units and the world contact model hardness index, edge radius (0.001 / index when unworn), wear, fracture, contamination and controlled contact, each marked observed, model value or failed against the rule thin-slice-food-drying-trial@1 applies, and whether all are met. Under this model every intact, unworn whole stone (index 8, radius 0.000125) or flint unit (9, 0.000111) meets it; each scratch stroke that wears a piece adds 0.00001 to its radius. Loose source units are not individually represented, so select reports what one gathered unit would show. Nothing is gathered, shaped, measured by an instrument or changed; no tool, equipment or food safety is created. Shaping is refused: the world has no fracture, flaking or sharpening law and abrasion only blunts. The drying trial still runs its own check and must be learned separately. No refund or reward.

details.costs: Study: 2 rounds, 0.5 energy each. open: inputStackId, your own unreserved, unspoiled, untreated food stack with a whole unit, not soft (hardness above 1); pressureToolIds, one or two of your own whole inedible rigid sound items; with one, supportId is a solid unreserved object of represented material in reach; with two, the second rests on firm ground where you stand. One round, 1 energy, one unit per attempt. inspect: inputStackId, your own food stack; one round, 0.2 energy. Both need light: outdoors daylight above 0.1, indoors light above 0.1. separate is refused. All checks run before any charge; gather, pickup and travel are separate.
details.effects: Strength is hardness / 10. The load reaching the unit is the lower of the two surfaces’ strength x (1 - flexibility). If it is not above the unit’s strength the outer layer holds and nothing changes. Otherwise damage (load - strength) / strength is added and kept on the unit: at 1 its outer layer splits open and the interior is exposed, below 1 it stays cracked and closed and can be pressed again. A larger stack gives up one unit; the rest is unchanged. The surfaces carry no more than their own strength, so they are not damaged. The unit stays one whole carried unit with its mass, nutrition, origin, age and decay; shell and kernel parts, masses and yield are not represented, so nothing detaches and nothing is separated. Inspect records the visible outer layer, crack, whether the interior is exposed, visible deterioration (of the interior only once exposed) and quantity as an unverified approximate record; edibility, nutrition, toxins and safety stay unknown. No eating, refund or reward.

packet.access: Omission is not absence. Query abilities, own inventory, knowledge, projects, memory, state or personally observed objects in batches. Ability search/list returns compact catalogue entries; use exact ids for full interface details and applicability. Search results are indexes. Exact queries return one record per offset. All paged records use600-code-unit fragments with zero-based part0..parts-1, consistently in proactive and queried views. Current-scope retained queries are reprojected using these stable pages; original results remain archived. Queries expose no hidden properties, other private records or historical capabilities. Queries do not perform physical trials or award experience. Exact-id queries return a complete record of up to 6000 code units as one value in a single result; larger records keep the paged form. Paged records omit their per-record notes: concatenate all parts before parsing; continue with the same exact id. An entry marked inRetrieval is shown with at least the same content under the same id in this input's retrieval. observation.terrain rows are "y:x:cells" strings: each character of cells is the terrain kind of one visible cell, at x, x+1, ... in row y. abilities.baseline entries with id, function and args summarize interfaces you neither used in the last 25 rounds nor need now. args lists the arguments in order: a bare name is a string; otherwise its type with any bounds (number>=lo, integer<=hi, integer lo..hi, and a bare lo..hi is a number range) or its choices a|b; ? marks an optional argument and "" means none. An exact abilities query by id returns the complete contract, including references and string limits of 200 or more code units.

value.name: Thin-slice food drying trial
value.function: Cut one whole unit of your own root or berry into thin slices with a carried stone or flint edge, lay them in one thin layer on open ground or a food surface to air-dry under actual weather, optionally keeping a carried same-stack control; inspect; re-lay slices you picked up; stop.
value.costs: Study: 4 rounds, 0.5 energy each. prepare: inputStackId, your own unspoiled uncut root or berry stack with 1 + controlQuantity whole units (one unit per trial); toolId, your own carried whole stone or flint unit whose edge passes the world contact model (radius at most 0.0002, hardness 8+, not fractured or contaminated); a layer area of 5 x unit mass: a ground footprint centred at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your radius, or supportId, a food surface in reach at least that large. One round, 1.5 energy. inspect: in reach of the slices or carrying them; one round, 0.2 energy. resume: re-lays slices you picked up, same placement rules, no cutting; one round, 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. All checks run before any charge; travel, gathering and pickup are separate. instrumentId is refused: no calibrated balance exists.
value.effects: Cutting keeps the unit's mass, water, nutrition, toxicity, decay and age; no offcut is represented; the edge gains no wear. Slices lie unowned as one sample with the world food water record (assumed water fraction root 0.75, berry 0.85; opening damage 1.1). Each round: water moves toward an equilibrium fraction 0.1 + 0.25 x air humidity (0.1-0.35) by at most 0.025 x area x (temperature - 5)/20 (0-2), so no gradient or warmth, no drying; rain on the uncovered layer adds 0.01 x rain x area; decay is the ordinary rate x 1.1 x (0.15 + 0.85 x water fraction/initial) (0.15-1.5), never reset. The control ages normally while carried. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, model decay of slices and control and their difference, visible shrinkage and wetness, and rain rounds as an unverified record; shrinkage does not measure water; spoilage, contamination, preservation and safety stay unverified. Anyone may take lying food: you taking the slices pauses the trial until resume; others taking them, spoilage, stop or death end it and release the control once. No refund or reward.
